desc:
👗 Welcome to Would You Rather: Dress Up Fashion Tower! 💅

Every floor gives you two portals. Pick one… and it instantly changes your outfit.

💥 Choose a portal
✨ Watch your look transform
😳 You never know what you're gonna get

Cute hair? A bold dress? A fit that makes the whole server stare?
You won't know until you've already walked through 😈

👠 Collect hairstyles, dresses, tops, skirts, heels, nails, and face & neck accessories
🎲 MILLIONS of outfit combos — every single run looks different
📈 Climb floor by floor and build your style piece by piece
👑 Reach the top and strut the RUNWAY in front of the whole server
🗳️ Everyone votes on the best outfit… will they crown YOU?

Will your final look be ICONIC… or a total surprise? 👀

👍 Like + ⭐ Favorite if you had fun!
🎁 Join the Group for free codes, rewards & updates
🔔 New outfits added every week!

Left portal or right portal? Choose wisely 😏
